title: subjects-raw.jsonl: one raw detection record per sampled frame (one JSON object per line)
description: The raw layer under subjects.json: every box every detector reported on a sampled frame, before tracking and de-duplication. Lines are appended as segments finish, so they are in scan order, not frame order; a frame appears once. Re-deriving subjects.json from this file needs no decoding. Positions: pixels of the stored video frame.

items.description: [class, model, x, y, w, h, score]
